premises.text: Traditional recruitment methods overlook high potential candidates due to bias towards prestigious backgrounds.
premises.evidence_span: evaluation today are based on criteria such as well-known schools or well-known companies. They favor prestige over potential.

premises.text: Deep learning technology can assess diverse experiences and backgrounds in resumes.
premises.evidence_span: Our unique deep learning technology is able to qualify every experience, project, education or transition people can write down in their resumes.

premises.text: The system can understand hidden correlations between different job experiences.
premises.evidence_span: our system is able to understand the different correlation, even if they are hidden.

premises.text: The solution can assess both technical and non-technical jobs across all languages and media formats.
premises.evidence_span: we are able to assess both technical and non-technical jobs. We are able to scale to all languages. And finally, we can deal with all media formats from PDF to images.

premises.text: Clients can identify more relevant talents and reduce the number of interviews needed for hiring.
premises.evidence_span: We allow our clients identify three times more relevant talents in their initial pools and reduce by 80% the number of interviews they do before making a hiring decision.

value.text: Recruiters can focus on emotionally intelligent tasks while using an efficient talent assessment tool.
value.evidence_span: we want every recruiter in the world to concentrate on tasks that are emotionally intelligent.

notes: Beta status and processing metrics are excluded as traction.
